meta.title: Master Lease - Real Estate Management Platform

intro.prompt: Real estate portfolio, property management dashboard

scenes.voiceover: Welcome to Master Lease. The complete platform for managing your real estate portfolio.
Click Run Deal Analyzer to bring the pricing suite into view.
Type a zip code to load live room comps and whole-home rents.
Load the zip profile so the system caches your market assumptions.
Add room comps to capture micro-level rent detail.
Add a whole-home comparable to benchmark overall performance.
Scroll through the analyzer to see the live profit stack.
Save the profile so the deal stays ready for your next pitch.
Every action is governed by Action Authority, keeping compliance locked in.
